body:
On December 2, we’re opening the doors to our first-ever App Studio, where you can turn your idea into a working app with a Lovable expert by your side. Free and open to the public for one day only, the experience includes sessions with experts, live demos, and exclusive creator talks.

Whether you want to make a tool for your business, an app for your community, or a personal gift for someone you know, you can reserve a session or walk in. You’ll work with an expert to describe your idea and shape it into something only you could make.

## Big ideas have a home in Atlanta

Lovable’s App Studio brings Make It Yourself, our brand campaign, into the physical world.

We chose Atlanta for our first pop-up because ideas rooted here have shaped music, film, design, and business far beyond the city. The App Studio is an invitation to bring that same imagination to software.

The independent creative spirit that Atlanta is known for reflects the belief behind Make It Yourself: people who understand their businesses, neighborhoods, and communities from the inside out should have the power to create for them.

One of those artists is PaperFrank , who’s creating a mural for the App Studio with a little help from the public. You’ll get to vote on the colors he uses before he paints the winning palette by hand on November 29. We’ll reveal the finished mural when the App Studio opens on December 2. Follow Lovable to keep up to date on when voting is open.

## The experience

Your session starts with what you know: a problem you encounter at work, an interest you want to explore, or something you wish existed. Then, you’ll work with a Lovable expert to bring it to life. Every corner of the pop-up will give you something to discover, from biscuits by a local chef who runs their business on Lovable to artwork by Atlanta artists. You’ll be surrounded by creators, customers, and the Lovable team, all there to make something together.

With the holidays approaching, it’s also a chance to make a personal gift, shaped by someone’s interests, your shared memories, or an idea only you would think to make for them. You’ll leave with your app and a boxed, one-of-one first edition commemorating your creation.

Throughout the day, creators will give exclusive talks about what they’re making with Lovable and how they’re building businesses around their expertise and audiences. Live demos will follow an idea from its first description to a working app.

We’d love to see you there— reserve a session or mark your calendar to walk in.

## Plan your visit

• When: Wednesday, December 2, 10 am–6 pm ET

• Where: Ponce City Market, 675 Ponce de Leon Avenue NE, Atlanta

• Admission: Free and open to the public, including expert sessions and talks

• Join us: Reserve time with a Lovable expert or walk in on the day
